geometry.slot_model: slot = zero-thickness polygon (CSXCAD AddPolygon, norm_dir z, elevation h) of an air Material (eps_r 1, kappa 0) with priority 20 > conducting sheet 10. Verified by reading the installed source: ContinuousStructure::GetPropertyByCoordPriority(coord, primList) returns the first priority-sorted primitive containing the edge coordinate; Operator::CalcPEC_Range and Operator_Ext_ConductingSheet::BuildExtension only act when that winner is METAL/ConductingSheet; Operator::AverageMatCellCenter samples cell centres (never on the z=h plane; drawing tolerance 0), so the zero-thickness air polygon does not alter substrate epsilon. NOT yet exercised in a solve.
geometry.polygon_meshing: round 6 rules (fixed_mesh_lines): 1/3-2/3 metal_edge_res rule on every axis-aligned metal/no-metal edge of patch, slots and line (board-edge coincident edges skipped), bounding-box extremes, plain vertex lines (dropped if < 0.1 mm from a rule/user line), merge of lines < 0.05 mm, merge of facing 'outside' lines < 0.7 * res, optional mesh_hint_lines_mm, bounded relaxation of fixed lines (<= 0.04 mm shift, target ratio 1.3 among fixed cells), then SmoothMeshLines with the ratio parameter lowered until the result is <= 1.4 (SMOOTH_RATIO_SEARCH); target 1.4, hard limit 1.5 (recorded in mesh_ratio_above_1p4_by_axis); staircase on oblique edges

slot_mesh_check.rule: >= 3 cells (centre inside the slot) across every chord >= 0.3 mm

port.type: ideal vertical lumped line; no pin/coax connector/aperture/deembedding
port.reference_plane: the lumped port itself (U and I integrated over z 0..h at the feed point); no plane shift, no beta, no de-embedding: the probe inductance belongs to the antenna

budget_before_solve.RAM_basis: P01_OPENEMS_002 RSS 758256 KiB / 4841937 nodal cells = 0.156602 KiB/cell, x2.0 margin
budget_before_solve.conservative_basis: 2048 B/cell, unmeasured; reference only, not used in the abort rule
budget_before_solve.time_basis: nodal cells * steps / 53 Mcell/s (measured in P01_OPENEMS_002); steps scale with 1/timestep from P01_OPENEMS_002 (10368 steps, record 3.930e-09 s); assumes the same physical record (resonator Q may lengthen it); capped by NrTS
budget_before_solve.abort_rule: do not launch if RAM (measured basis x2) > 8 GiB or estimated time > 4000 s
budget_before_solve.time_limit_basis: owner decision 2026-11-05: up to 4000 s for convergence runs

excitation.nominal_range_rule: spectrum exp(-2.25 (f - f0)^2 / fc^2) (openEMS excitation.cpp CalcGaussianPulse/MaxFreq): -20 dB at f0 +- 1.0116 fc
excitation.NrTS_EndCriteria_note: pulse length scales as 1/fc (fc 1 GHz: 2.87 ns; 2.5 GHz: 1.15 ns) and is far below the 30000-step cap; the energy criterion is relative to the peak energy, so it is unchanged; the step estimate in budget_before_solve keeps the 006 record length (conservative: a shorter pulse cannot lengthen the ring-down). Higher f_max only raises the probe sampling rate. Cells: xy <= 0.5 mm (lambda_FR4/27 at 10.5 GHz), air z <= 0.8 mm (lambda0/36). PML_8 and the NF2FF box (17.5 mm) are less effective at 5.5 GHz (box 0.32 lambda): outside-band content is for the port only; NF2FF frequencies stay in the channel.
